notes.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE: The new version is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Since the release of Galaxy Reavers, she has been a favorite of many players, but also received a lot of suggestions for improvement, and now we are trying to show your ideas step by step.

According to the majority of commanders, we will update the following in the near future:
[list]
[*]Optimize the combat operation experience, increase a variety of shortcut keys to operate, from single-mouse operation mode;
[*]Improve the game part of the game's gold output, allowing players to easily get more games gold coins;
[*]Reform of the supply system, substantially reducing the supply interval, a substantial increase in the number of supplies to receive；
[*]Reduce the purchase of shop experts packs the threshold, each player can easily get orange devices；
[*]A new level of difficulty, access to a large number of games gold and advanced devices, the challenge together!
[*]Optimize part of the UI interface and information display;
[*]Upcoming new warships, codename: flames queen!
[/list]

Currently, the new version has been in internal testing, we will be ready at the right time to launch the work, so stay tuned!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/eb18e1751f6fda150258a5340910aa703da41c0e.png[/img]

Follow updates on the game, we will continue to give full consideration to the views of players for development.
Also can be disclosed in advance, the multiplayer connection version has been in development, I believe in the near future will be able to meet with you.
Finally, we welcome the game community to give us more good ideas.

notes.title: Some Q&A about Galaxy Reavers-08/30/16
notes.notes:
Galaxy Reavers has gained a lot popularity since PC version was announced. Thank you very much, and we would like to answer some FAQ here.

Q> How much is this game?
A> We haven’t settled the price yet. We hope “Galaxy Reavers” could be on sale for a competitive price so that more players can enjoy it.

Q> Will there be any DLCs?
A> Yes, there will be DLCs for “Galaxy Reavers”, including some free ones. For more info about the DLCs, please stay tuned on us.

Q> Will there be In App Purchase in “Galaxy Reavers”?
A> No. There won’t be any In App Purchase in game. All resource can be gained in game.

Q> What kind of Steam functions are supported by “Galaxy Reavers”?
A> For now, we support the Steam Achievement in game. And we will support more Steam Functions in the future.

Q> Which languages are available in game?
A> For now, there are English, Germany, French, Russian, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese in game.

Q> What is the size of “Galaxy Reavers”?
A> “Galaxy Reavers” is of about 1GB.

Q> Is there enough featured content in this game? Will there be updates in the future?
A> There will be up to 65 Stages at the first version of release, including most of the warships and devices of the game. For more Stages and warships/devices, we will release them as DLCs and updates.

Q> How long it takes to clear all the Stages?
A> It depends. As we know, with different strategies, the time to clear stage varies. If you want to clear the stage ASAP, you may need to go for more battles to claim your war spoils and upgrade your fleet.

Q> Can I save my progress before quitting the game?
A> Yes, our game is auto-saved.

notes.title: 来自开发者的话：银河掠夺者PC版已经开发完成！
notes.notes:
很抱歉有超过1个星期没有及时发布消息，因为我们最近太忙了，但现在要和大家分享一个好消息：在我们的努力下，银河掠夺者PC版已经开发完成了！
现在游戏正在内部测试和Debug中，值得高兴的是，游戏已经可以稳定的在PC上运行了，现在我们会加倍努力，尽快能让大家玩到这个很有趣而又很有挑战性的科幻星战游戏！

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/77274c18e54d481f44eeade53ac0cd887708ea21.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/973f1941f88d2f2546a91837b138c87a0593e234.png[/img]
这是战舰库中某艘战舰高清截图，你可以在此自由旋转战舰视角，欣赏战舰的每一处细节。这艘战舰是我们设计得比较酷的一艘，我很喜欢她，你们喜欢吗？你们知道这艘战舰叫什么名字吗？

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/fcd06ec4aa39d6797bffa62d2ce248c3f95f1808.png[/img]
这是我们在测试版本试玩时截的3D战场战斗截图，无论是高速炮弹，还是远程导弹，还是鱼雷，电磁炮等等，在PC上都能够非常清晰的呈现出它们的攻击轨道，你可以自由旋转和拖动视角，欣赏每艘战舰精致的战斗细节，然后根据这些火力轨道进行判断飞行方向、急火目标和躲避攻击等战术操作，听起来是不是很酷呢？

notes.title: From Developers: Galaxy Reavers is now complete
notes.notes:
Commanders, sorry we haven’t post any updates since last week, because we were busy developing Galaxy Reavers. And here we are thrilled to announce: The PC version of Galaxy Reavers is now complete!

The current version is still under closed test and debug, and we are glad it runs stably on PC platform. We are trying our best efforts to push the progress so that everyone can play this fantastic yet challenging star war game as soon as possible.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/77274c18e54d481f44eeade53ac0cd887708ea21.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/973f1941f88d2f2546a91837b138c87a0593e234.png[/img]
This is one of the Warships, you can rotate the screen and view its details from all angles. This Warship is one of my favorite, with the designation of modern art. Fabulous, isn’t it? What’s its name? And what kind of attack will it have? Let’s see it in the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/fcd06ec4aa39d6797bffa62d2ce248c3f95f1808.png[/img]
This is a battle screenshot of the test version. As you can see, everything on the battlefield, including Warships, missiles, railgun and, their BALLISTICS! Yes, ballistics is one very key feature for Galaxy Reavers. And it’s also a useful feature to help you find out the enemies’ trace and strategy, so that you can decide how to how to avoid incoming attack, where to move, and which target to attack! Sounds awesome, right?

Galaxy Reavers will release very soon. For more update and news, please stay tuned on us! Thank you!

notes.title: From Developers: Galaxy Reavers' Steam Achievement -10/08/2016
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 
Today we are very happy to share a good news: the Achievement System of Galaxy Reavers is finished and we have uploaded it to steamwork!
For the steam achievements, we want it to give players some specific goals and point out how to play the game better. Thus we create a same achievement system in game, which consists of achievements as well as rewards to encourage players to grow stronger in game. For example, when you reach an achievement, you will highlight it on steam store, and be able to claim it in game. You will get a fortune: some coins, some devices, or even a warship!
It’s not yet time to release all the achievements, but here we talk about some of them and guess what they are for:

NO.1
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/5ae13e2dcab5c6f64f01cc09c3333866ee98c939.png[/img]
It’s a mystic pattern from deep of the universe, and is now commonly used as the badge of a fleet leader. Can you guess what this achievement stands for?

NO.2
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/b1752820159284e954ef742a1ed05104858a6b6e.png[/img]
This is a new type of warship. We have modified its design in order to show its mighty firearms. And we can say, you will have to go through a lot battles to acquire it!

NO.3
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/1be11c2f7513048b465473b622cdd6f7aa81bceb.png[/img]
Enormous ship body, broad deck, enabling more tactical devices and thus more powerful firearms. And this is why we use its prototype as the steam icon!

NO.4
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/831e476e699c730285757946cf0eedc0bd028015.png[/img]
These mini “airplanes” are actually newly developed drones, which usually work together to attack and tear their target in pieces! And they could be part of the tactical devices, installed in the giant warship!

NO.5
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/e9d99ce185e10e3844124e4003faa4afacf66b83.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/41c750e2fcf5457804deb2ac84c38151d8862e09.png[/img]
These icons are 2 different resources in game which a rea usually obtained by clearing stages. You can use them to repair warships, purchase new devices and better warships.

NO.6
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/6277a984161610ea3b5740e8198c1675313edfa6.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25743266/842d0bf67332a64c9daa59657d84283a5cac05dd.png[/img]
These 2 warships are invincibly mighty, and you will need great fleet and powerful devices to defeat them. Of course, along with your tragedy and manipulation!

This is the pre-release achievements for Galaxy Reavers today. And we may add more achievements/rewards in game in the future, as long as they’re popular!
Please leave your guess on what the achievements stand for, or how they’re achieved. We may draw some lucky players who hit the answer and give them the activation code for Galaxy Reavers!
Now, leave your answer!
